## UI polish: Team plan card 9 fixes across Tokens, Typography, Spacing, Layout and States. Text and brand hue kept. Tokens from design/tokens.css. ### Fixes 1. **Tokens**: raw colours that a variable already holds now use it. Card background `#ffffff` is now `var(--card-bg)`. Border colour `#d2dfde` is now `var(--card-border)`. Heading colour `#202d2c` is now `var(--color-text-default)`. Link colour `#0f766e` is now `var(--color-text-link)`. Button text `#ffffff` is now `var(--button-primary-text)`. (R-ui-polish-20, R-ui-polish-32) 2. **Tokens**: spacing and border width now use variables. Card `padding: 16px` is now `var(--card-padding)`. Heading margin `8px` is now `var(--space-8)`. Button padding `8px 12px` is now `var(--space-8) var(--button-padding-x)`. Border `1px` is now `var(--border-width-hairline)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 3. **Tokens**: type sizes and family now use variables. Heading `20px` is now `var(--font-size-xl)`. Link `16px` is now `var(--font-size-md)`. The font stack `system-ui` is now `var(--font-family-sans)`. (R-ui-polish-2, R-ui-polish-20) 4. **Tokens**: button radius `6px` is now `var(--button-radius)`, which is also 6px. (R-ui-polish-20, R-ui-polish-32) 5. **Typography**: the card had no line-height, so it is now `var(--line-height-body)`, and the heading gets `var(--line-height-heading)`. The button label was the browser default of about 13px. It is now `var(--font-size-md)` with `font-family: inherit`. (R-ui-polish-2, R-ui-polish-3) 6. **Layout**: the link and button were under 44 by 44 px. Both now have `min-height` and `min-width` of `var(--size-target-min)`. The link is `inline-flex` so the height applies. (R-ui-polish-7) 7. **Spacing**: the link and button touched each other. The button now has `margin-inline-start: var(--space-12)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-7) 8. **States**: link and button had no hover style. The link hover is `var(--color-text-link-hover)`. The button hover is `var(--color-neutral-800)`, a lighter shade of the same grey. (R-ui-polish-6) 9. **States**: link and button had no `:focus-visible` outline, and the button had no disabled style. Both get a 2px outline using `var(--border-width-focus)` and `var(--color-border-focus)`. The button gets `opacity: 0.5` and `cursor: not-allowed` when disabled. (R-ui-polish-6) ### Contrast | Text | Before | After | |------|--------|-------| | Heading | #202d2c on #ffffff, 14.25:1 | `--color-text-default` (#202d2c) on `--card-bg` (#ffffff), 14.25:1 | | Link | #0f766e on #ffffff, 5.47:1 | `--color-text-link` (#0f766e) on `--card-bg` (#ffffff), 5.47:1 | | Link hover | none | `--color-text-link-hover` (#0c403c) on `--card-bg` (#ffffff), 11.58:1 | | Button | #ffffff on #111111, 16.10:1 | `--button-primary-text` (#ffffff) on #111111, 16.10:1 (unchanged) | | Button hover | none | `--button-primary-text` (#ffffff) on `--color-neutral-800` (#364342), 10.30:1 | Ratios computed by hand with the formula; run the contrast script to confirm them. The contrast script could not run here: the command needed approval and was not allowed. ### Polished code ```html

I kept it as written because it already passes. Say "use `--button-primary-bg`" if the token should win. - Drift: the card radius is `12px`, and `--card-radius` is `8px`. `--r-md` is 10px and `--r-lg` is 14px, and neither matches.
